definitions.explanation: A small social insect that lives in organized colonies. Known for their industriousness and teamwork.

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{群|むら}がっている→群がる：15331_muragaru⟧。
examples.english: Ants are swarming around the sugar.
examples.notes: ⟦{群|むら}がる→群がる：15331_muragaru⟧ = to swarm, to gather

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{何倍|なんばい}→何倍：22969_nanbai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}べる→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Ants can carry many times their own body weight.

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A long line of ants stretched across the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蟻|あり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってきた→入る：00494_hairu⟧ので、⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}した→退治：14314_taiji⟧。
examples.english: Ants got into the kitchen, so I found their nest and exterminated them.

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧なのに、⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧まで⟦{運|はこ}んでいく→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Despite their small bodies, ants work together with their companions to carry large food back to the nest.

notes:
{蟻|あり} refers to ants in general.

Common expressions:
- {蟻|あり}の⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧ (a line of ants)
- {蟻|あり}の⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧ (ant nest, anthill)
- {蟻|あり}⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧ (antlion pit; also used figuratively for inescapable situations)
- ⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{蟻|あり} (worker ant; also used for hard-working people)

Counter: ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧

Related proverb:
{蟻|あり}の⟦{一穴|いっけつ}→一穴：noentry⟧ - "one ant's hole" - meaning a small problem can lead to big disaster, similar to "a small leak will sink a great ship."
